<b>Underpokes</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are extremely drained [[Underworkers]], only kept alive beyond their mortal limits by the [[Haunting]].<ref>Underpoke Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Drained worker on the verge of collapse. Consumed by the Haunting, they continue to work far beyond their mortal limits."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Underpokes often start off stationary, chipping away at objects, but take flight once Hornet approaches.<br>
Being flying enemies, they attempt to keep distance between themselves and Hornet, but fly closer to attack with either of their two attacks:
* <b>Triple Thrust:</b> Does three short thrusts in quick succession. Telegraphed by the Underpoke coming in more diagonally towards Hornet.
* <b>Flying Joust:</b> Rears back before performing a straight horizontal dash with their pin out, stopping once they hit a wall or Hornet is behind them. Telegraphed by them getting more distance and vertically aligning themselves with Hornet.

Underpokes deal {{Damage|1}} with both of their attacks, as well as on contact.

Due to their complete inability to attack below themselves, staying below them and constantly hitting them upwards is a viable and easy strategy. Additionally, they do not have any moves or AI to dash away if Hornet is too close, so they just keep flying downwards and getting hit back up.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Underpokes have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

{{SS Needolin|columns=2|

== Location ==
Underpokes can be found primarily in the [[Underworks]], with one encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the northwest of the area, two in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|gauntlet]] in the middle of the area, and another during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 3|gauntlet]] in [[the Cauldron]].

In [[Act 3]], a [[black-threaded]] Underpoke is fought during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 2|gauntlet]] in the ruined [[Cogwork Core]], and another spawns alongside a [[Void Mass]] in the Cauldron.
